name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia probe widens
summary: Indonesia names a fourth senior police officer in the Prabowo wiretap case; no G20 government collapse
state: Indonesian police arrested three senior officers on 3 Nov over alleged tapping of President Prabowo's phone, and a fourth senior officer was named a suspect by 6 Nov (The Star; Just Security). Troops were deployed in Jakarta as a security measure. No G20 government has fallen and no coup or contested election was reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Travellers to Indonesia should check FCDO travel advice. Political tension there has not disrupted daily life or travel at scale.
